name: 91203 · Glendale, CA
findings: ZIP 91203 (Glendale) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91203 (Glendale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
